FIGHTS.title: Heavyweight title
FIGHTS.note: Gane's first title defense. Hokit is unbeaten.

FIGHTS.title: Women's bantamweight title
FIGHTS.note: Nunes returns from about 41 months of retirement. Harrison returns from neck surgery.

FIGHTS.title: Flyweight
FIGHTS.note: Biggest upset of the night. Gurule dropped the unbeaten Hasan in R1, took him down in R2 and R3, and cut him with an elbow in R3.

FIGHTS.title: Welterweight
FIGHTS.note: Thompson's retirement fight. He snapped a three-fight skid and finishes his career at 18-9.

FIGHTS.title: Lightweight
FIGHTS.note: McKinney weighed 160.2, more than 4 lbs over, then needed under two minutes. Miller's 48th UFC fight.

FIGHTS.title: Middleweight
FIGHTS.note: Johnson's first pro loss. He came in unbeaten and favored.

FIGHTS.title: Women's bantamweight
FIGHTS.note: Mesquita called for a title shot after the finish.

FIGHTS.title: Bantamweight
FIGHTS.note: Diaz missed weight at 136.4. Heili took the fight on short notice.

FIGHTS.title: Lightweight
FIGHTS.note: Elder's first fight in about 19 months after a leg injury. Sanches was making his UFC debut.

rounds.t: Holland lands uppercuts, scores a trip takedown and attacks two ninja chokes. MMA Fighting scores it 10-9 Holland.
Medic looks to be favoring his left knee early. Action is paused after Medic lands a groin kick.

NOTES.t: Luis Gurule (+675) beats unbeaten Bilal Hasan (-1050) by split decision after dropping him in R1.
Cesar Almeida (+154) stops unbeaten Donte Johnson in R1.
Stephen "Wonderboy" Thompson retires on a spinning wheel kick TKO of Charles Radtke. Final record 18-9.
Terrance McKinney (160.2 for lightweight) missed by more than 4 lbs, then stopped Jim Miller in 1:53.
Juan Diaz (136.4 for bantamweight) missed and still beat short-notice replacement Alateng Heili.
Bia Mesquita asked for a title shot after choking out Macy Chiasson in R1.
Uros Medic may be hurt. He was favoring his left knee in R2 against Kevin Holland.
Amanda Nunes returns from retirement to face Kayla Harrison, who is back from neck surgery.
